3: /**
4:  * Get a property of a plain object
5:  * Throws an error in case the object is not a plain object or the
6:  * property is not defined on the object itself
7:  * @param {Object} object
8:  * @param {string} prop
9:  * @return {*} Returns the property value when safe
10:  */
11: function getSafeProperty (object, prop) {
12:   // only allow getting properties of a plain object
13:   if (isPlainObject(object)) {
14:     // only allow getting properties defined on the object itself,
15:     // not inherited from it's prototype.
16:     if (Object.hasOwnProperty.call(object, prop)) {
17:       return object[prop];
18:     }
19: 
20:     if (!(prop in object)) {
21:       // this is a not existing property on a plain object
22:       return undefined;
23:     }
24:   }
25: 
26:   if (typeof object[prop] === 'function' && isSafeMethod(object, prop)) {
27:     throw new Error('Cannot access method "' + prop + '" as a property');
28:   }
29: 
30:   throw new Error('No access to property "' + prop + '"');
31: }

33: /**
34:  * Set a property on a plain object.
35:  * Throws an error in case the object is not a plain object or the
36:  * property would override an inherited property like .constructor or .toString
37:  * @param {Object} object
38:  * @param {string} prop
39:  * @param {*} value
40:  * @return {*} Returns the value
41:  */
42: // TODO: merge this function into access.js?
43: function setSafeProperty (object, prop, value) {
44:   // only allow setting properties of a plain object
45:   if (isPlainObject(object)) {
46:     // only allow setting properties defined on the object itself,
47:     // not inherited from it's prototype.
48:     if (prop in object) {
49:       // property already exists
50:       // override when the property is defined on the object itself.
51:       // don't allow overriding inherited properties like .constructor or .toString
52:       if (Object.hasOwnProperty.call(object, prop)) {
53:         return object[prop] = value;
54:       }
55:     }
56:     else {
57:       // this is a new property, that's just ok
58:       return object[prop] = value;
59:     }
60:   }
61: 
62:   throw new Error('No access to property "' + prop + '"');
63: }

65: /**
66:  * Test whether a property is safe to use for an object.
67:  * For example .toString and .constructor are not safe
68:  * @param {string} prop
69:  * @return {boolean} Returns true when safe
70:  */
71: function isSafeProperty (prop) {
72:   return !(prop in {});
73: }

81: // TODO: merge this function into assign.js?
82: function validateSafeMethod (object, method) {
83:   if (!isSafeMethod(object, method)) {
84:     throw new Error('No access to method "' + method + '"');
85:   }
86: }

88: function isSafeMethod (object, method) {
89:   // TODO: remove this, replace with whitelist
90:   if (method === 'constructor') {
91:     return false;
92:   }
93: 
94:   // test for plain functions defined on the object (instead of a method)
95:   if (Object.hasOwnProperty.call(object, method) && isPlainObject(object)) {
96:     return true;
97:   }
98: 
99:   // only allow methods from the whitelist
100:   // TODO: also check whether this method is supported on given object
101:   return safeMethods[method];
102: }
103: 
104: function isPlainObject (object) {
105:   // TODO: improve this function
106:   return typeof object === 'object' && object && object.constructor === Object;
107: }
